title: Ican SN04 Fat Bike 6 Month Review  | DICKING ABOUT

takeaways.text: His SN04 with wide tires and a Reverb dropper weighs about 31 lb; he chose full suspension to protect his knees and back.
It handles well on sand, hardpack and roots and keeps up with friends on mountain bikes; he rides it more than his two expensive full-suspension bikes.

disclosure: Owner video from 2020; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: A six-month owner review of an ICAN SN04 fat bike, mostly a riding montage.
